company.name: Jama Tech LTD
company.description: A South Sudanese social enterprise working across environmental sustainability, digital transformation and essential supply chain logistics.
company.vision: To be South Sudan’s leading social enterprise in driving sustainable community development, empowering organizations through cutting-edge technology, eco-friendly resource management, and dependable supply chain logistics.
company.mission: To drive sustainable growth and resilience across South Sudan by delivering reliable supply chain solutions, eco-friendly recycling innovations, and robust digital infrastructure—empowering communities, businesses, and development partners to thrive in a connected world.

homepage.headline: Innovating for a sustainable, connected & resilient future.
homepage.introduction: A South Sudanese social enterprise turning local capacity into lasting resilience.

sections.title: Practical projects for a more circular future.
sections.body: Our plastic recycling work turns waste into a resource and supports more responsible use of materials. Through locally relevant projects and partnerships, we aim to contribute to cleaner communities and a more resilient South Sudan.

sections.title: Local capacity. Lasting resilience.
sections.body: As a South Sudanese social enterprise based in Juba, Jama Tech works across supply logistics, recycling, and digital services to support organizations and communities. We focus on dependable delivery and practical solutions shaped around local needs.

services.title: Food & Non-Food Items Supply
services.description: Dependable procurement and distribution. Essential supplies, delivered with care.
services.introduction: End-to-end procurement and supply chain management for humanitarian response, community development and institutional operations.
services.alt: An organised warehouse with storage racks and distribution equipment
capabilities: Dry food rations and quality testing
services.audience: Humanitarian organisations, procurement teams, government institutions and private enterprises.

services.title: Plastic Waste Recycling
services.description: Rethinking waste as a resource. Closing the loop for a cleaner environment.
services.introduction: Plastic waste processing and resource recovery that support a circular economy and help protect local ecosystems.
services.alt: Colour-coded containers used for separating recyclable materials
services.audience: Environmental organisations, institutions, local businesses and community partners.

services.title: ICT Consultancy & Digital Solutions
services.description: Practical technology. Smarter workflows. Stronger organisational capability.
services.introduction: Strategic advice, technical support and capacity building to help organisations modernise their operations and digital workflows.
services.alt: A contemporary workspace with computers and shared working areas
capabilities: Digital media production and drone operations
services.audience: NGOs, educational institutions, government departments and growing businesses.

services.title: Internet Infrastructure & Web Development
services.description: From reliable networks to thoughtful websites. Connecting you to what’s next.
services.introduction: Physical networks and purposeful digital experiences that help organisations work, communicate and grow in a connected world.
services.alt: Network infrastructure inside a server room
services.audience: Offices, project sites, institutions and businesses building their digital presence.
